title: IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The IVG Pro 12 Bundle delivers a sleek, powerful, and long-lasting vaping experience in one complete package. This exclusive set includes two complete IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kits plus two additional IVG Pro 12 Refill Pods. With four total 12ml units included, this bundle offers an immense supply of e-liquid and hardware, perfect for vapers who want all-day satisfaction with none of the upkeep. Each device is powered by a robust 1000mAh rechargeable battery and features a clear TFT screen that displays battery level and e-liquid status. The Pro 12 utilises a clever system where a 2ml prefilled pod is supported by a 10ml refill reservoir, offering up to 12,000 puffs per kit without refilling or changing coils. For those who want extra intensity, the optional Boost Mode adds vapour production with a quick double-tap of the power button. Draw-activated and ergonomic, the IVG Pro 12 combines simple handling with bold flavour and long-range performance. Available Bundle Flavours: The bundle gives you access to 15 bold flavour profiles. Choose from refreshing fruit blends like Blue Raspberry Ice and Pineapple Ice, sparkling soda options such as Fizzy Cherry and Pink Lemonade, or zesty citrus mixes like Lemon Lime. How To Set Up Your IVG Pro 12 Device Step 1 Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Step 2 Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Step 3 Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Step 4 Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Step 5 Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ Ready to vape
